mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_online_status (device_id, client_id, status, online_at) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{clientId}, 1, #{onlineAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE client_id = VALUES(client_id), status = 1, online_at = VALUES(online_at), offline_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE device_online_status SET status = 0, offline_at = #{offlineAt}, session_duration_sec = TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, online_at, #{offlineAt}) WHERE device_id = #{deviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_online_status WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_online_status WHERE last_report_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowMinutes} MINUTE)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO device_online_event_log (device_id, event_type, client_id, client_ip, event_time, reason) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{eventType}, #{clientId}, #{clientIp}, #{eventTime}, #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM device_online_event_log WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND event_type = 'OFFLINE' AND event_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{windowMinutes} MINUTE)
